central_entity.description: Atlantis is a legendary island first mentioned by the ancient Greek philosopher Plato in his dialogues 'Timaeus' and 'Critias.' It is described as a powerful and advanced civilization that existed around 9,000 years before Plato's time, which would place its existence around 11,000 years ago. The island was said to be rich in resources and possessed advanced technology and military power. The most famous aspect of the Atlantis legend is its sudden and catastrophic destruction, which Plato describes as occurring in a single day and night, with the island disappearing beneath the waves and leaving no trace behind.
